moments.title: US Open Tennis Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, begins today with qualifying rounds and the mixed doubles championship in New York, leading up to the main draw on August 30.

angles.name: Serve it up
angles.copy: Tennis fever is officially back! The US Open kicks off today with qualifying and mixed doubles. Who are you backing for glory in New York?

angles.name: Grand Slam action
angles.copy: It's the last Grand Slam of the year! The US Open is underway, with the main draws starting on Sunday. Get ready for two weeks of incredible tennis.

moments.title: Premier League: Fulham vs Chelsea
moments.blurb: Tonight sees a West London derby as Fulham host Chelsea in the Premier League at 8pm BST.

angles.name: Derby Night
angles.copy: Monday night football! It's a West London derby tonight as Fulham take on Chelsea. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: Monday Night Football
angles.copy: Don't miss a minute of Premier League action tonight! Fulham host Chelsea at 8pm. Predictions?

moments.title: Edinburgh Summer Sessions Ongoing
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Summer Sessions festival continues today and runs until August 29th, bringing live music to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Edinburgh Vibes
angles.copy: Still buzzing in Edinburgh! Summer Sessions continues this week with more live music. Who's been or is heading there?

angles.name: Scotland Live Music
angles.copy: Live music in Scotland! The Edinburgh Summer Sessions are in full swing until Saturday. Catch some incredible artists this week!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Still #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at Number 1 on the UK Official Singles Chart for an incredible 22nd non-consecutive week, with the new chart out this Friday.

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it 22 weeks at the top. Can anyone knock them off this Friday?

angles.name: Longest Reign
angles.copy: History makers! 'Rein Me In' continues its chart domination. What's your favourite Sam Fender or Olivia Dean track?

moments.title: Late August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's final Bank Holiday of the summer takes place this weekend, on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: The last Bank Holiday of summer is just days away! What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: It's almost here! The August Bank Holiday is traditionally the last hurrah of summer. Make it count!

moments.title: Creamfields Approaches
moments.blurb: The massive dance music festival Creamfields returns to Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27th to 30th.

angles.name: Creamfields Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is ON! Creamfields kicks off this Thursday. Who's ready to hit the fields in Daresbury?

angles.name: Festival Weekend
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for a huge weekend of dance music. What acts are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals This Weekend
moments.blurb: Two of the UK's biggest music festivals, Reading and Leeds, take place simultaneously from August 27th to 30th.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: Reading or Leeds? The ultimate festival showdown is just days away! Who's heading to which site this Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: Weekend Headliners
angles.copy: It's almost time for Reading & Leeds! Get ready for a massive weekend of music across both sites.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Mark Bedford
moments.blurb: Mark Bedford, the bassist for iconic British band Madness, turns 65 today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Mark Bedford of the legendary band Madness! What's your favourite Madness track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jean-Michel Jarre
moments.blurb: Pioneering electronic music composer Jean-Michel Jarre celebrates his 78th birthday today.

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the incredible Jean-Michel Jarre! His influence on electronic music is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jeffrey Daniel
moments.blurb: Jeffrey Daniel, best known as a member of the R&B group Shalamar and for his iconic dance moves, turns 71 today.

angles.name: Shalamar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the incredible Jeffrey Daniel of Shalamar! Those dance moves are still legendary.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Gene Simmons
moments.blurb: The legendary 'Demon' from KISS, Gene Simmons, celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Gene Simmons from KISS turns 77! Get ready to rock and roll all night.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Rob Halford
moments.blurb: Rob Halford, the iconic frontman of Judas Priest, turns 75 tomorrow.

angles.name: Metal God
angles.copy: Tomorrow we celebrate the 'Metal God' himself! Happy 75th Birthday to Judas Priest's legendary frontman, Rob Halford.

moments.title: Between The Trees Festival in Wales
moments.blurb: Between The Trees Festival, a nature-inspired music and arts event, takes place in Candleston Wood, Bridgend, Wales, from August 27th-30th.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Calling all Welsh festival-goers! Between The Trees kicks off near Bridgend this Thursday for a weekend of music and nature. Who's going?

angles.name: Bridgend Event
angles.copy: Live music in Bridgend! Between The Trees Festival brings a unique vibe to Candleston Wood from Thursday. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shania Twain
moments.blurb: The Queen of Country Pop, Shania Twain, will celebrate her 61st birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Let's go girls! On Thursday, we're wishing a very Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Florence Welch
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the lead singer of Florence + The Machine, turns 40 on Thursday.

angles.name: Florence Turns 40
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch from Florence + The Machine this Thursday! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Liam Payne
moments.blurb: Former One Direction member Liam Payne celebrates his 33rd birthday on Friday.

angles.name: One Direction Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 33rd Birthday to Liam Payne this Friday! What's your favourite 1D song?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Debbie Gibson
moments.blurb: 80s pop icon Debbie Gibson turns 56 on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Still 'Lost in Your Eyes'! Happy 56th Birthday to the amazing Debbie Gibson this Monday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Van Morrison
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Van Morrison will celebrate his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: A huge Happy 81st Birthday to the iconic Van Morrison this Monday! What's your go-to Van the Man track?

moments.title: End Of The Road Festival
moments.blurb: The End Of The Road Festival, known for its curated indie and alternative lineup, kicks off on September 3rd and runs until September 6th.

angles.name: Indie Festival Vibes
angles.copy: End Of The Road Festival is almost here! Kicking off on September 3rd, get ready for a weekend of amazing indie and alternative music.

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival Starts
moments.blurb: The Lindisfarne Festival, a music and arts event in the North East, runs from September 3rd to 5th.

angles.name: North East Festival
angles.copy: North East! Lindisfarne Festival kicks off on September 3rd for three days of music and good times. Who's joining the party?
